title: The United States needs an energy policy investors can bank on
gist: Argues that partisan whipsaw in US federal energy policy has become a priced cost of capital that delays infrastructure and raises consumer energy costs just as AI and data-center demand surges. Proposes grandfathering, predictable phase-downs, transparent system-operator methodologies and technology neutrality to make policy bankable.
